newsitem.title: USA: VIMRx gets add'l 450,000 warrants for stock priced.
newsitem.headline: VIMRx gets add'l 450,000 warrants for stock priced.

text.p: Epoch Pharmaceuticals Inc and VIMRx said they established an alliance to exploit synergies in their technologies and markets.

Under the deal, VIMRx invested $800,000 for Epoch common stock at $1.75 per share. In addition, VIMRx received 450,000 warrants exercisable at $2.00 and 450,000 warrants exercisable at $3.00 which expire in one and two years respectively.
They also agreed to settle an outstanding dispute between Epoch and a VIMRx German unit, formerly known as Ribonetics.
Richard Dunning, VIMRx's chief executive officer, was appointed to the Epoch Board of Directors.
